title: Warehouse Management Android App Development
excerpt: Develop a Warehouse Management Android application with distinct login roles for Admin, Operator, and Cashier. Managing warehouses, assigning operators, package scanning and delivery with SMS, Email, WhatsApp notifications.
content:
Develop a Warehouse Management Android application with distinct login roles for Admin, Operator, and Cashier. Features include managing warehouses, assigning operators and cashiers to warehouses, and handling package scanning and delivery processes.

The app provides warehouse-wise reports on upcoming, delivered, and delayed packages. Integrated third-party APIs for package information, and implement CRUD APIs for warehouses, operators, and cashiers. Include messaging capabilities via SMS, Email, and WhatsApp to notify package owners.

**Tech Stack:** Flutter, Dart, Android SDK, REST APIs, Firebase, MySQL

**Key Deliverables:**
- Role-based login (Admin / Operator / Cashier)
- Warehouse CRUD + assignment
- Barcode/QR scanner for package intake & delivery
- Reports: Upcoming / Delivered / Delayed
- Third-party API integration
- Notifications via SMS, Email, WhatsApp

**Results:** Streamlined warehouse operations and reduced delayed package rate by 35% for client Janafly (Saudi Arabia).
author: Shahid Alam
seoTitle: Warehouse Management Android App Development | The Dime Technology
seoDescription: Flutter warehouse management app with role-based login, package scanning, reporting and WhatsApp notifications built by The Dime Technology.

title: App Web and Mobile for Security ZKTEco - Biometric Integration
excerpt: Complete ZKTeco biometric ecosystem: Node.js/MySQL backend, Chainway P80 Ionic React tablet app and React web app with USB fingerprint readers. ADMS Push protocol, heartbeat and device sync.
content:
Scope of work covered:

**a. Backend (Node.js / MySQL)**
- Design and extend database tables for biometric template
- Develop APIs for biometric enrollment and retrieval
- Implement biometric data normalization and storage logic
- Build device synchronization and command queue system
- Implement ZKTeco ADMS Push protocol and heartbeat handling
- Generate and push biometric update commands to devices
- Implement retry, error handling, and basic logging

**b. Mobile / Tablet (Chainway P80 – Android / Ionic React)**
- Integrate Chainway P80 fingerprint SDK
- Capture fingerprint templates in compatible format
- Capture facial images using tablet camera
- Validate facial image quality and requirements locally
- Transmit biometric data securely to backend APIs

**c. Web Application (React + USB Biometric Devices)**
- Integrate Web app with USB fingerprint readers via local agent or SDK
- Capture fingerprint data from supported USB devices

**Results:** Successfully synchronized 50+ ZKTeco devices across client sites in UAE with <1s enrollment latency.

title: Automated MSSQL Database Backup Script Development
excerpt: Dedicated server script to automatically back up MSSQL databases (.BAK files) on a daily schedule, store in designated folder with retention and email alerts.
content:
We required a script to be developed for a dedicated server that will automatically back up MSSQL databases (.BAK files) on a daily basis or at a specified time.

The script stores the backups in a designated folder on the server. Reliable and efficient backup automation is essential to ensure data safety and easy recovery.

**Features:**
- Daily / scheduled MSSQL .BAK dumps via sqlcmd / PowerShell
- Retention policy (7/30 days)
- Compression + checksum
- Email alert on failure
- Log rotation

**Tech Stack:** Microsoft SQL Server, PowerShell, Windows Task Scheduler

**Feedback:** Client ATIT Solutionz (UAE) rated 5/5 — "great attention to detail. We are very satisfied and look forward to working with him again."
author: Shahid Alam
